description.value: Garden Fork is a casual sit-down restaurant in Brentwood Bay serving sandwiches, burgers, and coffee made with fresh, locally sourced ingredients. The restaurant is wheelchair accessible, accommodates large groups, and works with guests to meet dietary restrictions. It sits on West Saanich Road, a popular cycling corridor connecting the Saanich Peninsula communities.
